# The splitter reland restores saved sizes after choosing the layout axis

This landing chooses the pane layout axis before restoring XULStore dimensions. Splitter setters normalize finite numeric strings; restored sizing can remain pending until actual geometry and neighbor locks agree. Unresolved restoration retains a retry/listener path for later resize or visibility rather than guaranteeing completion after 60 frames. The selected tests directly check stored-size startup, drag persistence and delayed growth. Later classic-layout lock selection and keyboard/ARIA support remain separate. Required primary numbered comments 1/7/8/9/16 are absent with unknown authors/types; this is source-supported partial knowledge with zero full-audit credit and no runtime/layout test.

Scope: Pane splitter saved-size restoration.
